+        flights: A list of flight segments. Each item MUST be an object with keys 'flight_number' and 'date' (format 'YYYY-MM-DD'), e.g. {"flight_number": "HAT023", "date": "2024-05-26"}. Include EVERY segment.

+        passengers: A list of passenger objects. Each MUST use the keys 'first_name', 'last_name', and 'dob' (date of birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD'). Example: {"first_name": "Mia", "last_name": "Li", "dob": "1990-04-05"}. Do NOT use 'date_of_birth'.
